title: A Cop Pulled Over My Grandma for Speeding 🚓
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #grandma #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: My eighty-year-old grandma got pulled over doing ninety on the highway. And I was in the passenger seat.
scenes.image: an elderly woman about 75 with white curly hair, a pink cardigan and pearl glasses driving a small old car very fast on a highway, the narrator gripping the seat, police lights behind

scenes.text: The officer walked up and said, ma'am, do you know how fast you were going?
scenes.image: a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad leaning towards the driver's window

scenes.text: Grandma looked him dead in the eye and said, yes, young man. I'm eighty. I have to get everywhere before I forget why I left.
scenes.image: an elderly woman about 75 with white curly hair, a pink cardigan and pearl glasses replying confidently through the car window, a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad trying not to laugh

scenes.text: He tried not to laugh. Then he asked for her license.
scenes.image: a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad holding out his hand, biting his lip

scenes.text: She handed him her library card.
scenes.image: close-up of a library card being handed over, a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad confused

scenes.text: He said, ma'am, this is a library card. She said, I know. I read books about getting out of tickets.
scenes.image: an elderly woman about 75 with white curly hair, a pink cardigan and pearl glasses smiling sweetly, a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad staring at the card

scenes.text: The officer laughed so hard he had to walk back to his car.
scenes.image: a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad laughing and walking back to his police car, holding his stomach

scenes.text: He came back with a warning, and a request. Can you give my grandma driving lessons?
scenes.image: a polite young highway police officer with sunglasses and a notepad handing a paper to an elderly woman about 75 with white curly hair, a pink cardigan and pearl glasses, who winks at the camera
